about: drishti-views' conformance vectors for the ViewModel specification (contract 1.x, the pinned copy of drishti-rachana's spec/1/viewmodel.schema.json). Each view or frame has an id (stable: vectors are added, never renumbered), what it shows, and what a validator answers: ok (no error), and the issues, each {level, code, path}, compared as a set; strictOk and strictIssues for strict mode (when absent: the same as normal mode). V: valid; I: invalid; S: valid in normal mode, refused in strict mode; F: frames of the live stream. Synthetic data only.
